Great for capability. Terrible for trust. pass^k = "all k tries
articles.content: Agent evals are having a moment — pass@k is everywhere. But pass@k has a blind spot that bites production teams: it measures whether the agent can succeed, not whether it succeeds reliably . pass@k = "at least one of k tries succeeds." Great for capability. Terrible for trust. pass^k = "all k tries succeed." That's the reliability metric.
